user_story: As a platform owner, I want to create a client manually so that I can onboard pilot or offline clients without payment checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Client profile draft can be created; duplicate detection runs; tenant scope enforced; draft is auditable.
edge_cases: duplicate email; missing contact; tenant suspended

user_story: As a tenant admin, I want to assign a primary coach during client setup so that accountability is clear before invite.
acceptance_criteria: Only tenant coaches can be assigned; previous assignment preserved on reassignment; audit exists.
edge_cases: coach removed; coach outside tenant; reassignment mid-program

user_story: As a platform owner, I want to set a manual commercial gate with a reason so that no-charge or offline clients can access without hidden entitlement bypass.
acceptance_criteria: Reason required; gate visible in audit; Core access requested only after gate passes.
edge_cases: missing reason; revoked plan; no entitlement rule

user_story: As a tenant admin, I want to verify provisioning status so that I know whether the client can open the app and see the first step.
acceptance_criteria: Status shows invite, Core access, assignment, delivery plan and first login readiness.
edge_cases: Core pending; delivery failed; invite bounced

user_story: As a coach, I want to clone a journey template into my tenant so that I can adapt it without changing the source template.
acceptance_criteria: Clone creates draft; source remains immutable; validation warnings shown; canonical refs revalidated.
edge_cases: deprecated template; restricted refs; clone failure

user_story: As a coach, I want to create a cohort from a program template so that a group can move through shared content together.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort created; schedule configured; group delivery plan can be materialized; members tracked.
edge_cases: rolling vs fixed start; empty cohort; timezone mismatch

user_story: As a coach, I want to add clients to a cohort so that they receive group-program delivery and progress tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Client tenant matches; membership created; enrollment linked; delivery plan materialized.
edge_cases: client already in cohort; entitlement missing; cohort closed

user_story: As a coach, I want to create conditional branch rules so that clients can receive different paths based on intake or progress.
acceptance_criteria: Rule validates against schema; target exists; fallback required; publish blocks invalid rules.
edge_cases: orphan target; conflicting priority; invalid operator

user_story: As platform support, I want to inspect why a client saw a branch so that I can debug delivery without exposing private internals to the client.
acceptance_criteria: Trace includes rule, input snapshot, effect and actor/system source; tenant scoped; audit logged.
edge_cases: trace missing; restricted data; deleted rule

user_story: As a client, I want to see a clear next step even when the journey branches so that I never experience the app as broken.
acceptance_criteria: Client sees next step, locked state, coach review pending, or completion state; no raw rule terms shown.
edge_cases: pending review; no step available; revoked access
